occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: Bus # 2 and bus # 6 were missing first aid kits. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: One bus needed the fire extinguisher to be mounted in place.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions: One infant was missing a feeding sheet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions (26 TAC §746.801(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: Based on a DFPS investigation, it was determined  caregivers did not supervise and intervene to prevent a child from pulling over hot water on themselves.  This resulted in a burn injury requiring medical attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: This standard was reviewed as a part of a DFPS investigation. A child was neglected while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: This standard was evaluated as as a part of a DFPS investigation and found to be deficient. A caregiver left the chord to a bottle warmer hanging down, and a child was able to access the chord. This resulted in the child pulling over the bottle warmer and hot water spilling on the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: This standard was evaluated as a part of a DFPS investigation and was found to be deficient. A caregiver admitted to yelling at a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(6))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: This standard was evaluated during a DFPS investigation and was found to be deficient. A caregiver was using threats towards the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Hitting with Hand or Instrument: This standard was evaluated as a part of a DFPS investigation and was found to be deficient. A caregiver  used a wooden spoon to hit children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Hitting with Hand or Instrument (26 TAC §746.2805(4))
